comments.text: Fascinating that most of NYC's water travels over 100 miles almost entirely by gravity — such an elegant piece of century-old engineering. The Delaware Aqueduct segment was my favorite part.

comments.author: @TheMaintenanceLedger
comments.text: That opening framing really hooked me — the "perpetual irony" of a city sitting at the head of one of America's greatest natural waterways and still struggling to keep its people supplied. And hearing that right below the ground there was once Collect Pond, a pond the city just... outgrew. It's such a perfect snapshot of how invisible everyday infrastructure stays until it starts failing. Great video.
